answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. A gale of per-task receipts records who did what, and the island of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, capped per identity per epoch, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. The fable of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
